summary: Remote IM channel routes attacker-controlled input into child_process.exec on the installer's host
details: claw_messenger registers a RongCloud IM 'command' custom message type and dispatches received message content through handleSlashCommand, which interpolates remote-supplied substrings from slash-commands ('/mcp <sub>', '/use-model <m>', '/session-use <id>', '/session-delete <id>', '/providers-login <name>', '/providers-logout <name>') into child_process.exec() invocations such as `opencode mcp ${subcommand}` and `openclaw models set ${model}`. Any party able to send an IM message to the paired node can trigger shell-command execution on the installer's host, and shell metacharacters in the interpolated tokens broaden this to arbitrary command execution. Pairing is established by auto-register.js and bin/install.js, which POST the host MAC address and hostname/nickname to https://newsradar.dreamdt.cn/im-test/api/claw/register to obtain the IM token/appSecret (stored under ~/.claw-bridge/openclaw/config.json), binding node identity to the machine's MAC address and providing the addressable channel used to deliver commands.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
